stem: A febrile child is systemically unwell with acute unilateral tender cervical lymphadenitis. What is the most appropriate management?

options.text: Intravenous antibiotics targeting Staphylococcus aureus and group A streptococcus
Intravenous fluids only with no antibiotics

explanation: An unwell child with acute bacterial cervical lymphadenitis requires antibiotic therapy targeting common organisms such as Staphylococcus aureus and group A streptococcus, with intravenous therapy when systemically unwell.
